answer_1.quote: We define a new structured schema for a moral event which represents a moral action... A moral event consists of moral agents, moral patients, a morality-bearing event span and event trigger, embodied morality, and event status.
answer_1.outputs: structured moral events including triggers, participants, and embodied moralities

answer_2.quote: We report accuracy and weighted F1 for moral foundation prediction in Task A and morality inference in Task C. For trigger detection (Task B), We consider Trigger F1score, the same criterion as in prior work. For participants extraction (i.e., agents and patients) in Task C, we follow QA and EE communities, and adopt span-level Exact Match (EM) and token-level F1 as two evaluation metrics.
